intro: First update EVER, fam! 🎉 The weekend was a quiet one for our hero, so this kickoff edition rewinds to cover Thu Oct 22 through this morning. Grab a chonky cat and settle in.

items.caption: Monday morning and the man is already in @cosyposter's replies keeping it real. Relatable king.
Sunday Kansas pride check: he's got plans for the Flint Hills. Tourism board, call him.
items.quote: seems like we should be able to put some of these in the flint hills somewhere.

items.caption: Lordwilmehr served up a joke and our guy rated it, 😂 and all. Peak friendly-fire comedy.
GIF WARS! @lordwilmehr tagged in @Kansas_Cash and @WillPrompting, and our guy answered with a GIF. No words needed. 🎞️
Futurist mode: robots are coming, so naturally he asks @grok for the anti-robot game plan. Always prepared, never panicking (much).
items.quote: Hey @grok what is the best way for a human to stop an aggressive robot?  What should I get ready and EMP?

items.caption: Humble in victory, loud in signage. The YOLO manifesto we all needed.
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA I won’t brag when my YOLOs hit, but there will be signs

items.caption: Revolutionary new strategy just dropped. Wall Street is SHAKING. 📈
items.quote: $SPY I’m going to try buying low and selling high and see how that works for awhile.
